gmv.definition: 订单计数标记为 1 的订单行拆分金额合计
gmv.legacy_definition: SUMIFS(订单列表!CA:CA,订单列表!CB:CB,1,订单列表!AC:AC,复盘期)
gmv.formula: SUM(order_split_amount) WHERE order_count_flag=1 AND payment_confirmed_date IN period
gmv.time_semantics: 订单列表 AC：付款确认时间
gmv.shop_semantics: shop_key 映射 shop_pin 后过滤

refund_amount.definition: 订单计数标记为 1 的订单行汇总退款金额合计
refund_amount.legacy_definition: SUMIFS(订单列表!BZ:BZ,订单列表!CB:CB,1,订单列表!AC:AC,复盘期)
refund_amount.formula: SUM(order_refund_aggregated_amount) WHERE order_count_flag=1 AND payment_confirmed_date IN period
refund_amount.time_semantics: 按付款确认时间归因，不按售后发生时间
refund_amount.shop_semantics: shop_key 映射 shop_pin 后过滤
refund_amount.notes: 售后来源为 Standard 退款金额，Derived 仅按订单聚合

net_gmv.definition: 成交金额 - 退款金额

refund_rate.definition: 退款金额 / 成交金额
refund_rate.null_policy: 成交金额为 0 返回 null

order_count.definition: 订单计数标记为 1、出库状态为已出库、拆分金额 > 10 的记录数
order_count.legacy_definition: COUNTIFS(订单数,1,出库状态,已出库,订单号拆分金额,>10,AC,复盘期)
order_count.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE order_count_flag=1 AND shipment_status_normalized='已出库' AND order_split_amount>10
order_count.shop_semantics: shop_key 映射 shop_pin 后过滤
order_count.notes: >10 是旧 Excel 明确存在的业务规则

refund_order_count.definition: 订单计数标记为 1、出库状态为已出库、汇总退款金额 > 10 的记录数
refund_order_count.legacy_definition: COUNTIFS(订单数,1,出库状态,已出库,订单号汇总退款金额,>10,AC,复盘期)
refund_order_count.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE order_count_flag=1 AND shipment_status_normalized='已出库' AND order_refund_aggregated_amount>10
refund_order_count.time_semantics: 按付款确认时间归因，不代表售后表真实退货日期
refund_order_count.shop_semantics: shop_key 映射 shop_pin 后过滤
refund_order_count.notes: 名称保留旧表‘退货订单数’，实际公式为退款金额阈值

return_rate.definition: 退货订单数 / 总订单数
return_rate.null_policy: 总订单数为 0 返回 null

ad_cost.definition: 当前 Excel 口径的三类推广表花费合计
ad_cost.legacy_definition: 快车花费 + 全站计划花费 + 全站全店花费
ad_cost.shop_semantics: shop_key 映射 shop_pin 后过滤
ad_cost.notes: 暂不确认其为最终生产公式，保留对账用途

roi.definition: 净成交额 / 推广花费
roi.null_policy: 推广花费为 0 返回 null

estimated_profit.definition: 复现旧 Excel 参数公式，业务含义待确认
estimated_profit.legacy_definition: 净成交额 × (1-平台费-税率-毛利参数) - 推广花费
estimated_profit.notes: 当前参数 0.09/0.03/0.7，仅用于复现，不解释毛利含义
